description: Bug report → repro test card → fix card → deterministic verify. Run: nklein workflow run bug-report --input "<bug description>"

steps.title: Capture the starting state as evidence

card.title: Repro test: {input}
card.prompt: Write a FAILING automated test that reproduces this bug: {input}. Do not fix the bug — the test must fail against current code and clearly name the expected behavior.

steps.title: Fix the bug against the repro test

card.title: Fix: {input}
card.prompt: Fix this bug: {input}. A repro test was just added by a previous card — make it pass without weakening it, keeping the change minimal.

steps.title: Full test suite must be green
